name: Boku no Ue ni Yuki Furitsumoritsu
original_name: ぼくのうえにゆきふりつもりつ
source:
Sora lives a miserable life in a cruel world. She has food and a place where to sleep. Her memory is blurry and she wants to have fun from time to time. Is there an end to this misery?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
